inventory.visualPurpose: Fatty acid synthesis vs β-oxidation mirror map
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The p. 87 figure: synthesis (citrate shuttle out, ATP citrate lyase, ACC with CO2-biotin and insulin/glucagon, malonyl-CoA, palmitate 16C) vs degradation (fatty acyl-CoA synthetase, CPT-I, carnitine shuttle, β-oxidation acyl-CoA dehydrogenases, acetyl-CoA → ketone bodies/TCA) across cytoplasm/membranes/matrix zones, with the malonyl-CoA ⊟ CPT-I inhibition.

notes: The single source figure is a full redraw: the mirror map with both shuttles crossing the mitochondrial membranes band, the malonyl-CoA ⊟ CPT-I interlock arrow, the ACC hormone markers, both deficiency cards, and the source mnemonics in the footer.
